jobs.description:
SamenvattingLooking for an active warehouse job in an international and modern environment? As a Warehouse Operator in Rotterdam, you play an important role in handling and preparing parts for electric scooters, bicycles, and e-scooters. You make sure everything is picked, packed, and shipped correctly, so customers receive their orders on time. A great opportunity to work in a fast-growing and sustainable industry with a motivated team. Good work!Over de functieAs a Warehouse Operator, you work with a wide range of parts – from small components like screws to complete bikes and scooters. You help keep the warehouse running smoothly from start to finish.
Your tasks include:
- Receiving and inspecting incoming shipments
- Ensuring inventory accuracy
- Picking, packing, and preparing orders for shipment
- Supporting physically demanding warehouse tasks as required by the operation
- Maintaining a safe and clean work environment

This is a full-time position (40 hours per week).
Working hours: Monday to Friday, 07:30 – 16:00
Over het bedrijfThis company is an international leader in smart mobility solutions, focused on sustainable transport such as electric scooters, bicycles, and e-scooters. Their mission is to make cities cleaner, more efficient, and more accessible through innovative mobility.
You will work in a modern, international warehouse environment with motivated colleagues from all over the world, contributing to a fast-growing and future-oriented industry.
Wat wij vragenGood command of the English language
Experience in a warehouse environment is a plus
Team player with a positive and flexible attitude
Motivation and willingness to learn

We are also curious about your experience and motivation — surprise us!
Wat wij biedenStarting salary from €15 gross per hour
Full-time job (40 hours per week)
International working environment
Weekly payments

Product Manager Finance (English)

You are the link between users, technology, and the internal organisation, translating market needs into solutions while contributing to the company's strategic objectives. 
As Product Manager Finance at 4PS, you combine financial expertise with strategic product management. You dive into the challenges our customers face, keep up with developments in finance, and translate these insights into smart software solutions within 4PS Construct. You work closely with customers, consultants, developers, and other stakeholders to ensure our financial solutions continue to meet the evolving needs of the market. 
You are responsible for the vision, development, and continuous improvement of the Finance domain within our software. It is a role where you constantly balance customer needs, product strategy, and technical possibilities. Our product: 4PS Construct 
Our product, 4PS Construct, is an ERP solution for companies in the construction, installation, and project-based industries. Thousands of users rely on our software every day to efficiently manage their projects, processes, and financial administration. 
To make our software practical and efficient for all end users, we have developed various solutions that are fully integrated with 4PS Construct. These include web portals, apps, and visual planning modules that can be used across different devices. In short, a complete end-to-end solution. 
Finance plays a crucial role within this solution. As Product Manager Finance, you ensure that our financial solutions continue to meet customer needs, respond to market developments, and address future challenges within the industry. What challenges will you take on? - You are responsible for the strategic development, launch, and continuous improvement of our financial solutions. - You help shape the product vision and manage the roadmap for the Finance domain...

Are you a hard worker who feels at home in a dynamic logistics environment? For our client in Son & Breugel, we are looking for a Logistics Employee who is ready to roll up their sleeves. Your tasks will include:

- Picking orders
- Packing and preparing orders for shipment
- Checking shipments for accuracy and completeness
- Loading and unloading goods

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning components using modern machines or manually
- (Dis)assembling components based on technical drawings

Packaging components in the cleanroom to ensure they arrive at the customer in perfect condition
